Test fonts of the font converter, made by test/font/gen.py with fontTools:
subsets of STIX Two Text 2.13 b171 (https://github.com/stipub/stixfonts,
SIL Open Font License 1.1, see OFL.txt) as TrueType, CFF, WOFF, WOFF2, a
collection, a variable font, a font whose OS/2 fsType forbids embedding and
one with COLRv0 color glyphs; and features.ttf, a font of rectangles whose
GSUB and GPOS hold a lookup of each kind. The script's docstring lists what
each holds.
